title: Amazon’s Zoox just won the first US OK to charge for rides in a no-wheel robotaxi
excerpt: Amazon’s Zoox has become the first company allowed to charge for rides in a robotaxi that has no steering wheel and no pedals. US regulators granted the exemption on Wednesday. It is a first for the driverless-car industry. The clearance
content_html:
Amazon’s Zoox has become the first company allowed to charge for rides in a robotaxi that has no steering wheel and no pedals. US regulators granted the exemption on Wednesday. It is a first for the driverless-car industry.

The clearance came from the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, and was first reported by Reuters. It lets Zoox run a paid service in vehicles built from scratch as robotaxis, rather than modified cars. Its electric, carriage-style pod seats four facing inward and tops out at 75mph.

What the exemption actually does

Federal rules assume a human driver, with a steering wheel, pedals and mirrors. Zoox’s vehicle has none of them. NHTSA waived eight of those rules written for human drivers to let the pod on the road.

Until now, Zoox could carry passengers for free in parts of Las Vegas and San Francisco. The new exemption lets it charge, subject to state and local sign-off, and it told TechCrunch it will start in Las Vegas.

There are limits. Zoox still cannot sell the vehicles to the public, and it is capped at 2,500 cars a year for two years. Its chief executive, Aicha Evans, called it “the first-ever commercial exemption for a purpose-built robotaxi.”

A leash attached

The approval comes with strings. NHTSA is adding reporting requirements for crashes and for stopping inappropriately on roads. Remote operators must be based in the US. Zoox must publish maps of where its cars run.

The regulator kept a way out. “We have the ability to pull the exemption if we see major safety issues,” said its administrator, Jonathan Morrison.

The caution is not abstract. This month the agency told the industry to fix a “clear pattern” of driverless cars interfering with police and first responders. Robotaxis have been misbehaving on public roads, driving around stopped school buses and freezing at flooded intersections. Zoox itself recalled its fleet of 105 cars in July over software that might miss heavy smoke.

Ahead of Tesla, behind Waymo

The milestone matters most against rivals. Alphabet’s Waymo leads US robotaxis, but it retrofits conventional cars. Tesla is building a Cybercab with no controls too, yet has not set out a path to approval.

Zoox is first to clear the federal hurdle for a purpose-built vehicle. NHTSA says it wants the first federal safety standards for self-driving by the end of the Trump administration, and is funding a $5m, three-year effort toward a single national rulebook. For now, Zoox gets to charge, on a short leash.

content_html_zh:
亚马逊旗下的 Zoox 成为第一家获准对没有方向盘和踏板的机器人出租车进行收费的公司。 美国监管机构周三批准了豁免。 这对于无人驾驶汽车行业来说尚属首次。

该许可来自国家公路交通安全管理局，并由路透社首先报道。 它让 Zoox 在从头开始建造的机器人出租车（而不是改装汽车）上运行付费服务。 它的电动马车式吊舱可容纳四个面向内的座位，最高时速为 75 英里/小时。

豁免的实际作用

联邦法规假设驾驶员为人类，配有方向盘、踏板和后视镜。 Zoox 的车辆没有这些。 NHTSA 放弃了为人类驾驶员制定的八项规则，让 Pod 上路。

到目前为止，Zoox 可以在拉斯维加斯和旧金山的部分地区免费载客。 新的豁免允许它收费，但须经州和地方批准，它告诉 TechCrunch 它将从拉斯维加斯开始。

有限制。 Zoox 仍然无法向公众出售这些车辆，并且两年内每年的销售量上限为 2,500 辆。 其首席执行官艾查·埃文斯 (Aicha Evans) 称其为“有史以来第一个针对专用机器人出租车的商业豁免”。

附有皮带

该批准带有附加条件。 美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 正在增加对车祸和道路上不当停车的报告要求。 远程操作员必须位于美国。 Zoox 必须发布其汽车行驶地点的地图。

监管者留了一条出路。 “如果我们发现重大安全问题，我们有能力取消豁免，”其管理员乔纳森·莫里森说。

这种警告并不抽象。 本月，该机构告诉业界，要修正无人驾驶汽车干扰警察和急救人员的“明确模式”。 机器人出租车在公共道路上行为不端，在停着的校车周围行驶，在被洪水淹没的十字路口结冰。 Zoox 本身在 7 月份召回了其 105 辆汽车，原因是软件可能会漏掉浓烟。

领先于特斯拉，落后于 Waymo

对于对手来说，这一里程碑最为重要。 Alphabet 的 Waymo 在美国机器人出租车领域处于领先地位，但它对传统汽车进行了改造。 特斯拉正在建造一款同样没有控制装置的 Cyber​​cab，但尚未制定批准途径。

Zoox 是第一个清除联邦专用车辆障碍的公司。 NHTSA 表示，希望在特朗普政府任期结束前制定第一个自动驾驶联邦安全标准，并斥资 500 万美元，为期三年，旨在制定单一的国家规则手册。 现在，Zoox 可以在有限的束缚下发起冲锋。
